olfactory_bulb_R->insula_R.quote: The mitral cells in the olfactory bulb are the principal source of afferent input to the primary olfactory cortex. These afferents pass via the lateral olfactory tract to layer Ia of the cortex, making excitatory synaptic contacts with the apical dendrites of pyramidal cells (1a) and with horizontal (1b) elements.

The middle and deep tufted cells project to sites in the olfactory cortex different from those of mitral cells. Mitral cells use glutamate as a transmitter at their axon terminal and dendritic output sites.
